description: Set buyer-aware pricing for your workspace: the mode (off, shadow or live), which model prices in live mode, and which request fields the models may read. Live changes the prices your buyers are quoted, always inside the exploration band, never below cost and inside your price guardrails. A field left out keeps its saved value; null goes back to the default. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope; from the dashboard, an owner or admin.

features.description: The request fields the models may read. Default buyer type and channel. Customer segment and geo are off unless you add them: in the EU, pricing consumers by location is restricted and personalised prices must be disclosed. null goes back to the default.

mode.description: shadow: each buyer model prices quotes on the side and only logs its price (the default); live: the chosen model prices learned and optimizer quotes, inside the exploration band and your guardrails; off: nothing runs. null goes back to shadow.

model.description: Which model prices in live mode: auto (a promoted hosted model, else the contextual bandit, else the boosted model), bandit, boosted or hosted. null goes back to auto.

name: set_buyer_aware_pricing
